question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Alight
solution:
The correct answer is **"Descend."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Alight"** means to descend from a train, bus, or other form of transportation. (बस, रेलगाड़ी आदि से उतरना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The suspect **alighted**__ from the train at Euston and proceeded to Heathrow.*
 
 
 
• Synonyms of **alight** include **descend, disembark, and get off**.
 
• **"Descend" **means to go down to a lower place; to go down something. (नीचे आना; उतरना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The plane started to **descend**__ and a few minutes later we landed.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, Commence **means to begin or start something. (आरंभ होना)
 
• **Option 2, Earn** means to receive money or compensation for work done. ((पैसा) कमाना)
 
• **Option 3, Enlighten** means to inform or educate someone about something. (अपेक्षित जानकारी देते हुए किसी बात की समझ को बढ़ाना)
